en.headline: North Point owners' corporation fined over worker's fall
en.dek: Eastern Magistrates' Courts fined the Kingsfield Garden corporation HK$149,000 after a tree worker fell from a car-park wall last July and later died.
body: An owners' corporation in North Point was fined HK$149,000 at the Eastern Magistrates' Courts on Monday for breaches of safety rules after a worker pruning a tree fell and later died, RTHK reported.

The man had been working at Kingsfield Garden in July last year when he fell about 1.2 metres from the top of a parapet wall at the car park. He was taken to hospital conscious with a head injury and died two weeks later.
The court found that the incorporated owners had breached the Occupational Safety and Health Ordinance. The Labour Department brought the prosecution.
The case was heard on Monday. The report did not name the worker.

zh.headline: 北角業主立案法團因修剪工人墮下被罰14.9萬
zh.dek: 東區裁判法院星期一裁定京士花園法團違反職安條例，罰款14.9萬元。工人去年七月在停車場矮牆墮下，兩星期後不治。
body: 港台報道，北角一個業主立案法團星期一在東區裁判法院被判罰款14.9萬元。案情指一名修剪樹木的工人墮下後不治，法團被控違反安全規定。
該名男子去年七月在京士花園工作，從停車場矮牆頂墮下約1.2米，送院時清醒，頭部受傷，兩星期後去世。
法院裁定該住宅大廈的業主立案法團違反《職業安全及健康條例》。檢控由勞工處提出。
案件星期一審結。報道沒有公布工人姓名。
